text: The purpose of this report is to appoint Council Members to the Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender, Queer and Two-Spirit (LGBTQ2S+) Advisory Committee.

City Council on June 29 and 30, 2020, adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint the following Members to the Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender, Queer and Two-Spirit (LGBTQ2S+) Advisory Committee for a term of office until December 31, 2020 and until successors are appointed: Councillor Kristyn Wong-Tam, as Chair Councillor Paul Ainslie
